title: Sunday School
summary: We will read and discuss John 21
details:
After a night of catching nothing, the disciples encounter the risen Jesus on the shore—and everything changes.

Why does Jesus ask Peter three times, “Do you love me?” Is Peter being forgiven, tested, or given a new mission?

As we conclude our journey through the Gospel of John, we'll explore a miraculous catch of fish, breakfast with the risen Christ, and Jesus' powerful invitation: “Follow me."

Join us for a conversation about failure, forgiveness, second chances, and what it really means to follow Jesus.
